title.narrative: SUPPORT TO TANZANIA WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY AND TANZANIA NATIONAL PARKS IN THE PROTECTION OF AFRICAN ELEPHANTS IN SELOUS GAME RESERVE, NYERERE NATIONAL PARK AND ADJOINING AREAS, TANZANIA

description.narrative: NYERERE NATIONAL PARK (NNP) AND SELOUS GAME RESERVE (SGR) ARE SOME OF AFRICAS OLDEST AND LARGEST PROTECTED AREAS, LOCATED IN THE SOUTHEASTERN PART OF TANZANIA WITH A TOTAL AREA CLOSE TO 50,000 KM2. SGR AND NNP FORM THE CORE OF AN EVEN LARGER NETWORK OF PROTECTED AND CONSERVATION AREAS, THE NYERERESELOUS ECOSYSTEM ALSO INCLUDES 10 COMMUNITY WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT AREAS AND IS APPROXIMATELY 110,000 KM2. ELEPHANTS RANGE ACROSS THIS ENTIRE SYSTEM. THE PURPOSE OF THE PROJECT IS TO STRENGTHEN SGR AND NNP PROTECTION AND HUMANELEPHANT CONFLICT RESPONSE CAPACITY TO ENSURE THE RECOVERY AND LONG-TERM SURVIVAL OF THIS CONTINENTALLY IMPORTANT POPULATION WHILE PRIORITIZING THE SAFETY OF THE COMMUNITIES CO-EXISTING WITH ELEPHANTS. THROUGH THE PROVISION OF AERIAL SUPPORT TO PATROL THESE VAST PROTECTED AREAS AND SUPPORT TO RANGERS MOBILITY THROUGH THE MAINTENANCE OF PATROL VEHICLES, ANTIPOACHING EFFORTS FOR SGR AND NNP WILL BE STRENGTHENED. THIS PROJECT PRIORITIZES THE SAFETY OF COMMUNITIES IN THE LANDSCAPE BY WORKING CLOSELY WITH TANZANIAN AUTHORITIES AND COMMUNITIES TO INCREASE THE NUMBER AND CAPACITY OF RESPONSE TEAMS. FINALLY, BY PROVIDING SUPPORT FOR THE MONITORING OF ELEPHANTS AND PRELIMINARY STAKEHOLDER ECOSYSTEM PLANNING, THIS PROJECT WILL INITIATE A PROCESS OF FINDING LONG-TERM SOLUTIONS TO HUMANELEPHANT CO-EXISTENCE.
